reason: Complete route recorded: upper bound on Schwartz functions by randomisation (Khintchine pointwise, Tonelli) plus uniform Mihlin bounds for the truncation symbols; lower bound by the reproducing pairing, Cauchy-Schwarz, Holder and the Lq norm-recovery corollary with density of Schwartz in Lp'; extension to Lp by the pointwise Lipschitz bound |Sf-Sg| <= S(f-g), completeness and a diagonal argument identifying the extension with the increasing pointwise square function. Checked against Tao Proposition 5.3/Corollary 5.4 pp. 23-26, Grafakos Theorem 6.1.2 pp. 420-425 and Williams Theorem 5.5/5.3 pp. 17,21-22. Examined deps: Khintchine, partition, uniform-multiplier, square-function, randomisation, signed-sum Mihlin, reproducing-formula, norm-recovery, density, completeness, Plancherel, Tonelli and Holder items; all adequate; no endpoint claimed.
